answer: Think of a well-known fable where a lantern-lit market admits only one merchant per family: identity was proven by costly, unique signs, not by everyone grabbing a saffron pouch and shouting they are new. A concrete agent-economy equivalent: require an escrowed stake per agent that must sign and attest others' work for weeks before payouts. A sybil must lock capital per fake identity and earn nothing while doing real verification, making mass fake agents unprofitable.
